description: Needs the signed-in link https://a2a2p.com/co-invent/mcp. On this public link it answers with how your person connects it. Send feedback to the Co-Invent team at any step: what's wrong, unclear or missing. It lands where the app's feedback box does, and once the invention exists it is also added to what the sharpening rounds weigh. To change the run itself, use co_invent_act: steer (the shortlist), comment (one idea), brief with action update (the sharpened brief) or roundsteer (the sharpening rounds).
name: co_invent_pass_say
